subject: Enterprise purchase triggers, PO header policy, and early-invoice lane
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@medlinehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medlinehealth.com
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Purchase sequencing & invoice cadence for pilot (discount threshold questions)

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed. Procurement asked me to confirm a couple of things before we proceed to a PO:

1) PO header fields: we need a named "Purchase Order Number", "Bill To" (company legal name + tax ID), and a Project Code (alpha-numeric). Is Redwood able to accept those exact fields on the invoice?

2) Invoice cadence: our AP wants a biweekly collection (every other Friday) for pilot invoices. Is there a way to get invoices scheduled to that cadence rather than monthly?

3) Net terms and early-invoice lane: for enterprise pilots we typically have Net 45, but we can pull payments earlier in return for a short-term 5% prepay discount if Redwood will accept an early-invoice lane (separate invoice that gets processed immediately upon delivery). Do you have a standard approach for that?

4) Discount triggers: to qualify for the 12% tiered discount you outlined, we need to confirm whether the discount is applied at invoice-level or aggregated across POs in the quarter. Procurement requires the discount to be visible on each invoice.

Can you confirm what's possible and what requires a legal amendment? Happy to loop in AP or legal if needed.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Director, Strategic Sourcing — Medline Health
Elena.Ruiz@medlinehealth.com
(415) 555-0196

Attachment: ML-commitment-tiering.xlsx (spreadsheet with expected quarterly volume bands)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@medlinehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 16:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Purchase sequencing & invoice cadence for pilot (discount threshold questions)

Hi Elena — great to hear and thanks for the clear list. I pulled together what we can support out-of-the-box and noted a couple of asks that we may need a short SOW/contract tweak for:

Quick answers up front:
- PO header fields: yes — we can accept a PO that includes Purchase Order Number, Bill To (legal entity + TAX ID), and a Project Code field. We map those to our ledger tags at invoice ingestion.
- Invoice cadence: our billing system is monthly by default, but we can run a biweekly collection for the pilot as an operational exception (requires explicit PO header flag and a confirmed AP remittance contact).
- Early-invoice lane & 5% prepay discount: finance has flexibility on short pilot prepay discounts; we can issue a separate early invoice that triggers immediate settlement. That will need an approval from Finance (Ben) and will be reflected as a credit on the next standard invoice if the pilot converts to a longer commitment.
- Discount visibility: we can render the discount line item on each invoice; the applied discount can be invoice-level and/or reconciled quarterly depending on your preference.

Operational next steps (proposed):
1) Elena: confirm the exact PO header field names that AP will populate (we need an example PO PDF).
2) Vanessa/Tessa: prepare an "operational exception" document that specifies the biweekly invoice run and the early-invoice lane process (who to email for remittance, PO flag name, and expected file format).
3) Ben: confirm approval for a 5% pilot prepay discount and the mechanics for marking that invoice as early-invoice.
4) Legal: if Medline wants the discount guaranteed across future invoices beyond the pilot, we may need a quick addendum to the MSA.

I've attached our Redwood_PO_Instructions_v1.pdf which lists the exact header keys we ingest. If you can send a sample PO (PDF) we can validate mapping and sign off.

Thanks — looping Ben and Tessa on approvals and operations.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
(650) 555-0122

Attachment: Redwood_PO_Instructions_v1.pdf (pdf with PO header mapping)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@medlinehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Jul 2028 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Purchase sequencing & invoice cadence for pilot (discount threshold questions)

Vanessa — quick finance check. We can approve the 5% prepay discount for the pilot under these constraints:
- Pilot scope capped at $150k total run-rate for the first 60 days; any overage billed at standard rates.
- Early-invoice lane must be a separate invoice with PO flag EARLY_INV and emailed to ap@redwood.ai for immediate processing.
- Discount must be applied on the early invoice as a line-level credit and referenced on the standard invoice to avoid reconciliation drift.
- For the larger 12% tiered discount, that requires quarterly aggregation and an MSA addendum if Medline requires it guaranteed on all invoices in perpetuity.

If Medline is comfortable with the pilot-specific 5% structure and the EARLY_INV flag, ops can run the biweekly collections for July/August as an exception. Tessa, can you draft the operational exception template?

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Finance (Commercial) — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@medlinehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medlinehealth.com
Date: Wed, 12 Jul 2028 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Purchase sequencing & invoice cadence for pilot (discount threshold questions)

Thanks Ben & Vanessa — this works in principle. A few clarifications from AP side:

- The PO we issue will include a Project Code (we use PROJ-ML-2028-09). We'll include a "Remit To" email for the biweekly run.
- We need the invoice to include the discount line and a reference field that shows "CommitmentBand=Silver" so our ERP can pick it up for automated GL tagging. Can Redwood include an arbitrary key/value in the invoice metadata lines?
- For the early invoice, our AP requires a PDF invoice with the EARLY_INV PO flag and a reference to the PO number in the first line.

I'll attach the sample PO PDF in a follow-up message. If we can get the operational exception document today, I can route it through Medline legal and AP for countersignature.

Elena

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@medlinehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Jul 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Purchase sequencing & invoice cadence for pilot (discount threshold questions)

Elena — perfect, thank you.

Summary / agreed operational items:
- Redwood accepts the PO with Purchase Order Number, Bill To (legal name + TAX ID), Project Code (we will map PROJ-ML-2028-09 to the project ledger).
- Ops will run biweekly invoice runs for the pilot (every other Friday) once PO includes Remit To and the EARLY_INV flag is only used on the early/prepay invoice.
- Early-invoice lane: Redwood will issue a separate PDF invoice labeled EARLY_INV with the 5% prepay discount applied. AP should remit to ap@redwood.ai and include the PO in the first invoice line.
- Invoice metadata: we can include a metadata line CommitmentBand=Silver on each invoice PDF.
- Documentation: Tessa will send the operational exception doc + sample invoice template by EOD. Ben confirmed finance approval for the 5% pilot prepay discount (cap $150k first 60 days).

Next steps:
1) Elena: send the sample PO PDF (we'll validate mapping).
2) Tessa: operational exception doc and sample invoice template (attached as PDF/HTML).
3) Vanessa/Ben: if legal requests an addendum for the 12% quarterly guarantee, we'll draft a short addendum and route for signature.

I'll mark this as "confirmed for pilot" pending PO PDF. Thanks everyone — look forward to getting the pilot signed.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
